lines.say: Vitamin D. Could it be holding your strength back?
Your skin makes vitamin D from sunlight.
But in winter, far from the equator, or indoors all day, many people run low.
Your muscles have vitamin D receptors, and low levels are linked with weaker muscles.
In studies, supplements improved strength a little, mostly in people who were low to begin with.
So the smart move is a blood test, not guessing.
More isn't better. Very high doses can be harmful. Follow your doctor's advice.
